steps.interviewer_question: Hello The Casual Novice. Our telemetry shows you abandoned the application during initial onboarding. Why did you leave?
steps.persona_response: I clicked the link expecting a quick solution, but was immediately confronted with a heavy setup flow.
steps.behavioral_diagnosis: Initial Action Barrier (Fogg Ability Threshold Exceeded)

steps.interviewer_question: Why did the setup flow feel so heavy?
steps.persona_response: It demanded 1 input fields and forced account creation before I even saw what the tool actually did for me.
steps.behavioral_diagnosis: Violation of Simplicity Sieve (Mental & Physical Effort Friction / TTV Delay)

steps.interviewer_question: Why didn't the potential benefit justify taking 2 minutes to fill out those fields?
steps.persona_response: Because I didn't have proof of value yet. Every modern app promises the world, but asking for my credentials upfront felt like homework.
steps.behavioral_diagnosis: Asymmetric Investment Demand (Demanding Investment before Variable Reward)

steps.interviewer_question: Why were you looking for an application like this in that exact moment?
steps.persona_response: I was feeling overwhelmed and rushed. I needed an instant answer, not a new software project to manage.
steps.behavioral_diagnosis: Misalignment with User Context & Cognitive Bandwidth

steps.interviewer_question: What was the core underlying emotional itch you were trying to solve?
steps.persona_response: Deep down, I felt acute boredom. When your product added friction instead of soothing that discomfort, my subconscious reacted by closing the tab.
steps.behavioral_diagnosis: ROOT CAUSE: Failure to relieve the internal trigger (boredom) within 3 seconds.

churn_interviews.actionable_remediation: Implement progressive disclosure: Remove registration gate, provide an instant sandbox/preview, and defer account creation until user attempts to save their work (Stored Value).
